description: End-to-end nightly ETL: SFTP inbound PGP-encrypted feed -> decrypt -> import to staging -> SQL normalize/validate -> promote to Shared_ProductCatalog -> data extract for BI -> encrypted export -> cleanup. Demonstrates every Automation Studio activity type used in this program.

steps.description: Import Activity: CSV -> Staging Data Extension

activities.name: Import-Product-Catalog-To-Staging
activities.fieldMapping: Header row match (SKU, ProductName, Category, SubCategory, Brand, Price, SalePrice, InStock, InventoryCount, ImageURL, ProductURL, AvgRating)
activities.notes: Overwrite import type is intentional — the feed is always a full nightly snapshot, not incremental.

steps.description: SQL Activity: Validate + Promote to Live Catalog
Script Activity: Post-import row-count sanity check with automated halt on anomaly
Data Extract Activity: anonymized nightly order snapshot for BI team

activities.name: Extract-Anonymized-Orders
activities.notes: SubscriberKey is one-way hashed (SHA-256 + salt) in the source query; no PII leaves the platform in this extract.
